# Burning Springs: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Locations 130 to 153

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 22, 2025
- 8 min read

Updated: Dec 3, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_057cd04bdee94505807b1ed892a173eb~mv2.jpg)

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

This route is meant to be run from

**130 to 153** 

Some spawns are out of the way and rely on the previous spawn to reach the next one. I set the path up so you can grab the briefcases needed for the Abraxo weapons as fast as possible.

Each location has a tick box under it so you can mark them off as you go.

If you want the full list all on one page, use the

Burning Springs: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Rewards and Checklist

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 130**

Fast Travel Point:

- Albany

Directions:

From the spawn in location, run straight ahead toward the ruined brick building beside the red truck trailer. Go around the right side and jump up onto the second floor. Face east and follow the room around to your left. Open the wooden door. The briefcase is on top of the filing cabinets along the north wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f39fe5125a9d42819e3c39383cfc9304~mv2.jpg)

Reward Unlocked: Rusted Abraxodyne Sign

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_045473787bbd4c66a04d2b432273b3f1~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 131**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face south and walk to the edge of the second floor. Turn to face southeast and you’ll see a white house with a red front door across the road. Walk over to the house and go around it until you find the red door on the right side of the building, not the front door. Go inside and take the stairs to the top floor. At the top of the stairs, face south. The briefcase is on the metal shelf in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_60d5cebe69db48c7a413bb2908aa471e~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 132**

Fast Travel Point:

- Westbrook Horse Ranch

Directions:

From the spawn in location, run over to the red and white barn in front of you. Go inside and face east. The briefcase is on the wooden table between the locker and the hay bale.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3f908c0ad54848ecaca0feec8a29b095~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 133**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face south and exit the barn through the back door. Keep heading south toward the paddock behind the barn. When you’re standing in the middle of the paddock, face east and walk over to the white horse trailer on your right. The briefcase is on the ground at the back of the trailer.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e500aac1c8064406a0cd3e9891db7c19~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 134**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump onto the trailer and face south. Run forward until you reach a small pond filled with water. On the left side of the pond is a cave. Go inside and face east. The briefcase is on a rock shelf toward the back of the cave.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fce20ab9e3c743dcb90d7c6545379d66~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 135**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the cave and face southwest. Run forward and stop in the middle of the dried river bed near the fort. Face southeast and run until you reach the small campsite with the blue canvas tents. The briefcase is next to the tent on the right, beside the orange metal cart, leaning against the wooden crates.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c9b906d212e441329df180c335c1f7be~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 136**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face west and run forward. Cross the bridge and turn southwest. Walk over to the red canoes on your left. The briefcase is on the canoe on the far left, at the bottom of the rack.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6c34d9a295b44241aeaf20a6a21fe131~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 137**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

Level 1 Locked Door

From the spawn above, jump on top of the canoe at the top and face west. You’ll see a path leading up to the fort between the rock walls. Follow the path up and jump the fence into the fort. Keep heading west and follow the path between the two buildings. Stop at the end of the path and turn north. Walk forward and jump over the railing of the building in front of you. Take a few steps forward and unlock the door on your right. Go inside, follow the hallway around, and open the office door. The briefcase is under the desk on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fbeb8495385d4fc2aab7098c927903c4~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 138**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around and exit the building. On your left, there’s a wagon and some display cases. Stand on the display cases at the end and face south. Walk forward, veering slightly right, and go through the gateway in the wall. Keep heading south and jump over the wall in front of you. Look down, and the briefcase will be on your left, leaning against a pile of sandbags.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_85c8c69d7e5c4629be21c30875bf77e7~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 139**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face west and run forward. Keep going and jump the fence until you’re outside the fort and standing in the middle of the car park. Turn north and walk forward, past the small building, and stop at the main road leading up to the fort. Turn left, walk forward, and the briefcase is on your left, leaning against the sign behind the skull robot light.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fe3e2d22568f49b288567c610d449a98~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 140**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face south and follow the dirt road all the way out to the main road. Turn left at the Abraxodyne trailer and follow the road east. Jump over the guard railing and stop on the roof of the trailer. Look down and you’ll see four blue and white tables with umbrellas. The briefcase is next to the table on the left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4564e35671244d9a8ad25465407a0408~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 141**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump back on top of the trailer and face south. Run forward, veer slightly right, and keep heading up the road. Stop when you see the red, blue, and orange shipping containers on your left. Turn left and you’ll see a ramp leading up the scaffolding at the far end of the containers. Head up the ramp and climb all the way to the very top. Face west, and the briefcase is at the end of the platform in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cd7e6b7fb383417a85db7d712bba1833~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 142**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face east and walk to the end of the platform. Turn south and look down. You’ll see a black-roofed shed on the ground below. Jump over the railing and land on the roof. Face south, step off the roof, then turn around so you’re facing the door. Open the door, go inside the shed, and the briefcase is in front of you on a metal cabinet.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5bb897050d1d4358a28b33c233451fd9~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 143**

Fast Travel Point:

- Sand Fork Lumber

Directions:

From the spawn in location, face north and run over to the green forklift. Turn northeast and run over to the red shed in front of you. Face north, and the briefcase is leaning against the weapons workbench on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d516be6b514c4b5fbcd42a100a731122~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 144**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face east and run forward until you reach the main road. Turn southeast and run past the ruined house, stopping at the windmill behind it. Face south, jump the fence, and walk forward slowly. The briefcase is half buried in the field on your right, just past the phosphate deposit.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cf31888fabc842a291084e97656d36e2~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 145**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face west and run straight until you reach the main road. Turn south and follow the road all the way to the end. Go past the house and enter the collapsed tunnel in front of you. The briefcase is inside the rusty car on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_480caece6c8e42e08228c2a691c93e34~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 146**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 147**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 148**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face north and follow the road until you reach a car accident with Abraxo barrels and red powder all over the ground. Jump onto the back of the rusty green ute/pick up truck, and the briefcase is in the left corner of the tray.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b498687661ae4fa486d89188593515b8~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 149**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face north and follow the road past the police car, then past the cream and green rusty car on your left. Stop at the third car in front of you. Jump onto the bonnet of that car and face east. Run forward, veering slightly left. Stop at the edge of the cliff and look down. You’ll see a black-roofed shed on your left on the other side of the fence. Jump the fence and find the door of the shed. Go inside, and the briefcase is on the ground in front of you, leaning against some wooden crates.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6da431be7b4846b0a2d83710346df5db~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 150**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn toward the hill on your left and run up until you reach the main road. Face north and follow the road, past the giant bucket on your right, and stop at the white gravel road on your right. Turn right and follow the path down to the covered bridge. The briefcase is in the back of the van on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_55730f03aa45406bbc73264aeb871302~mv2.jpg)

Reward Unlocked: Prototype ABX03

Image credit Wulf_BearClaw

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_acb381b4873445ce8e613ee8ae72e9b1~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 151**

Fast Travel Point:

- Tycoon Lake

Directions:

From the spawn in location, face north and follow the dirt path. Stop at the bus shelter on your left and jump onto the roof. Turn toward the right-hand side of the fence line in front of you and look down. Count three fence panels from the right. Behind the third panel is a tree stump. Jump down and run over to the stump. The briefcase is under it, next to a skeleton and a shovel.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_254ea9e7b9504ba88545953dfa30d97e~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 152**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face northwest and run over to the van in front of you. Jump onto the roof. Face west and you’ll see a blue van ahead of you on the right (and no, it’s not a player’s survival tent). Run over to the van and find the door. Go inside and turn left. The briefcase is on the bench at the end.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_07b10b1c67164591b168728e59f106cf~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 153**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the van, face north, and run back to the main dirt road. Face west and follow the road. Stop at the motorbikes on your left. The briefcase is leaning against the front wheel of the first motorbike on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_acbcd9d9d27c459d8940afbf3e954d9b~mv2.jpg)
